description: This source file contains unit tests for error handling, exception propagation, and asynchronous behaviors within an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes tests for grain reference creation, error scenarios, task faulted states, delayed method execution, stress testing, argument serialization, observer disconnection, and hash distribution. The class ErrorGrainTest extends testing infrastructure to verify robustness and correctness of Orleans error handling patterns.

classes.name: ErrorGrainTest
classes.description: Contains a suite of unit tests to validate error handling, asynchronous operations, and system robustness for Orleans grains and infrastructure.

methods.name: ErrorGrain_GetGrain
methods.description: Verifies that error grains can be referenced and basic methods invoked without errors.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingLocalError
methods.description: Tests handling of locally thrown exceptions within a grain context, ensuring standard .NET exception behavior.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingGrainError1
methods.description: Confirms that grain methods throwing exceptions correctly fault their tasks and propagate errors to callers.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingTimedMethod
methods.description: Validates that long-running grain methods complete correctly, with timing considerations.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingTimedMethodWithError
methods.description: Tests delay and subsequent exception in a long-running grain method, verifying proper faulted state and timing.

methods.name: StressHandlingMultipleDelayedRequests
methods.description: Performs stress testing by invoking many concurrent delayed grain calls to assess stability and resource management.

methods.name: ArgumentTypes_ListOfGrainReferences
methods.description: Checks serialization and transmission of collections containing grain references as method arguments.

methods.name: AC_DelayedExecutor_2
methods.description: Tests Orleans' delayed execution support by scheduling a delayed task and verifying its completion.

methods.name: SimpleGrain_AsyncMethods
methods.description: Verifies asynchronous grain pattern correctness for setting and getting state.

methods.name: SimpleGrain_PromiseForward
methods.description: Tests forwarding of promises between grains and correct result handling.

methods.name: SimpleGrain_GuidDistribution
methods.description: Assesses hash distribution and load balancing based on different GUID patterns for grain IDs.

methods.name: ObserverTest_Disconnect
methods.description: Validates observer disconnection handling in event notification patterns.

methods.name: ObserverTest_Disconnect2
methods.description: Validates observer disconnection when multiple subscriptions exist.
